name: Better Trail
description: Add a Wave Trail to all gamemodes!

open-menu.name: Open menu
open-menu.description: The keybind that will be used to open this menu.

button-in-pause-menu.name: Button In Pause Menu
button-in-pause-menu.description: Whether or not to show the Wave Trail settings button in the pause menu.

enable-wave-trail.name: Enable Wave Trail
enable-wave-trail.description: Whether to enable the default Wave Trail or not.

enable-ship-trail.name: Enable Ship Trail
enable-ship-trail.description: Makes it so that the Ship gamemode has a Wave Trail.

enable-ufo-trail.name: Enable UFO Trail
enable-ufo-trail.description: Makes it so that the UFO gamemode has a Wave Trail.

enable-swing-trail.name: Enable Swing Trail
enable-swing-trail.description: Makes it so that the Swing gamemode has a Wave Trail.

enable-cube-trail.name: Enable Cube Trail
enable-cube-trail.description: Makes it so that the Cube gamemode has a Wave Trail.

enable-ball-trail.name: Enable Ball Trail
enable-ball-trail.description: Makes it so that the Ball gamemode has a Wave Trail.

enable-robot-trail.name: Enable Robot Trail
enable-robot-trail.description: Makes it so that the Robot gamemode has a Wave Trail.

enable-spider-trail.name: Enable Spider Trail
enable-spider-trail.description: Makes it so that the Spider gamemode has a Wave Trail.

trail-in-platformer.name: Enable Trail In Platformer
trail-in-platformer.description: Enable Wave Trail in Platformer Mode.

enable-trail-color.name: Enable Trail Color
enable-trail-color.description: Enable color override for the Wave Trail (will override main and secondary player trail colors).

trail-color.name: Trail Color
trail-color.description: Color override for the Wave Trail.

trail-rgb-duration.name: Trail RGB Duration
trail-rgb-duration.description: The loop duration of the Trail RGB.

trail-rgb-saturation.name: Trail RGB Saturation
trail-rgb-saturation.description: The saturation of the Trail RGB.

solid-wave-trail.name: Solid Wave Trail
solid-wave-trail.description: Makes the Wave Trail a solid color instead of it blending with the background and being glowy.

trail-size.name: Trail Size
trail-size.description: The size the Wave Trail will have, by default, 10.

disable-pulse.name: Disable Pulse
disable-pulse.description: Disable Wave Trail pulsing to the song.

use-main-player-color.name: Use Main Player Color
use-main-player-color.description: Whether or not to use the player's main color for the Wave Trail.

use-secondary-player-color.name: Use Secondary Player Color
use-secondary-player-color.description: Whether or not to use the player's secondary color for the Wave Trail.

use-glow-player-color.name: Use Glow Player Color
use-glow-player-color.description: Whether or not to use the player's glow color for the Wave Trail.

hide-regular-trail.name: Hide regular trail
hide-regular-trail.description: Hides regular trail if wave trail is enabled.

hide-particles.name: Hide particles
hide-particles.description: Hides particles if wave trail is enabled.

do-offset.name: Do Offset Trails
do-offset.description: Adds an offset to the Wave Trail in Ship and UFO gamemodes so that it looks more real.

length-limit.name: Trail Length Limit
length-limit.description: The length limit the wave trail will have on the rest of gamemodes (not wave one).

point-threshold.name: Trail Point Threshold
point-threshold.description: How often the trail will add a new trail point.
